prompt:

Header text verbatim: "en bokning". Smaller English meaning verbatim: "reservation".
Scene: An adult hotel guest showing a confirmation card with bed symbol to a receptionist, matching bed symbol and check mark on desk screen, no names or room numbers.
Memory-link caption verbatim: "bokning = reservation; a place kept for you.".
Swedish example in bottom strip verbatim: "Vi har en bokning på hotellet.".
Teach only the sense shown by this sentence. Print only the supplied heading, English meaning, memory caption and Swedish example. If the caption contains a sound/spelling association, mark it with the small exact label "Memory trick".
